target: Fulfill the canonical intent of engos-design-experience.
intended_outcome: Preserve the canonical SSOT objective and required output.

primary_outcome.definition: Canonical task success with protected behavior preserved.

promotion_rule: Change-class-specific proof plus all hard gates; no aggregate compensation.
rollback_trigger: Any protected regression or stale bound evidence.

source_clause_hashes.text: - **Make consequential options tangible.** When structure is unsettled, compare the smallest useful sketch, mockup, or working slice with the active draft using comparable content and fidelity. Try the same task; expose benefits and costs. Preserve settled directions. No fixed variants, agents, or steps are required. [The diagnostic example](resources/examples/worked-decisions.md) shows why added context can also weaken a composition.

Do not invent facts, APIs, research, or validation. Distinguish supported, proposed, and mocked behavior. Check relevant access/input in the actual target; disclose gaps. Images cannot prove interaction, browser simulations cannot prove native behavior, and agent reviews cannot establish human outcomes.
Judge task fit, composition, continuity, truthful semantics, access, and proportionality from the artifact. More context, novelty, or features do not establish quality.
